exclude.term: Exclude any PRE or KI Pending orders

exclude.logic: Exclude any customer who is on an Employee Purchase Program (EPP) rate plan or account type

exclude.logic: Exclude any customer whose most recent transaction was made through a corporate store channel

exclude.logic: Exclude all customers with a Quebec province address or billing province code of QC from the dialing list

campaign_summary: This outbound call campaign targets TELUS postpaid mobility customers who are single-subscriber accounts, scored in the AAL recommendation module (ranks 1–8), on shareable data plans (5G+ or premium unlimited), and located within the TELUS Fibre or Bell Fibre (Vulcan) eligible footprint. The offer promotes adding a new mobile line (Add-A-Line) with an Internet cross-sell component, dialed via the TIIN site under CSS campaign ID AALVUL. Key exclusions include existing Koodo Internet, Altima, and Start.ca internet customers; customers with pending PRE or KI orders; EPP subscribers; customers whose last transaction was at a corporate store; and all Quebec records, with dialing prioritized in Ontario (in-footprint first), then other East provinces, then AB/BC.
